_comment: apps/api. Every issue in this project is a genuine fault by construction:
middleware/error.ts reports only what isFault() accepts, which excludes
every 4xx ApiError - a wrong password, a taken address, a route that does
not exist. So this rule does not need filters to be quiet. It is quiet
because the thing feeding it already is.
project is the numeric id from MONITORING_DSN's path, and it is no longer
part of the URL. A workflow is org-scoped and binds to a project through
a DETECTOR, so apply.sh resolves this project's issue_stream detector at
apply time and fills in detectorIds. The detector id is deliberately not
written here: Sentry creates it per project, it means nothing to a
reviewer, and pinning it would break the day a project is recreated.
